Terms.Name: Administer
Terms.Description: Manage or apply procedures for control or compliance

Terms.Name: Amputate
Terms.Description: Execute, used metaphorically to describe cutting off parts of a group or structure

Terms.Name: Apply
Terms.Description: Put into action or use a particular tool or procedure (e.g., apply forward pressure)

Terms.Name: Cauterize
Terms.Description: Take drastic or severe action to stop something harmful (e.g., an infection or rebellion)

Terms.Name: Document
Terms.Description: Record or observe details, possibly about citizens or locations

Terms.Name: Examine
Terms.Description: Inspect closely, potentially for assessment or to find faults

Terms.Name: Inject
Terms.Description: Introduce a substance or directive, into a system or population

Terms.Name: Innoculate
Terms.Description: Protect against future threats through intense security measures

Terms.Name: Inquire
Terms.Description: Locate and retrieve a subject for interrogation

Terms.Name: Intercede
Terms.Description: Intervene in situations, potentially to stop certain actions or conflicts

Terms.Name: Interlock
Terms.Description: Lock together, unite to form a firm cohesive structure or team

Terms.Name: Investigate
Terms.Description: Look into an event or anomaly more closely, gathering information

Terms.Name: Isolate
Terms.Description: Separate an individual from the rest of a group to take punitive action

Terms.Name: Lock
Terms.Description: Secure an area or mechanism, preventing entry or manipulation

Terms.Name: Pacify
Terms.Description: To subdue or incapacitate a target, usually via non-lethal means

Terms.Name: Preserve
Terms.Description: Maintain order or keep an area secure from external threats

Terms.Name: Pressure
Terms.Description: Apply force or pressure, likely to control or subdue an area or individuals

Terms.Name: Prosecute
Terms.Description: Take legal or military action against an individual or group

Terms.Name: Restrict
Terms.Description: Limit movement or access, implementing controls over an area or people

Terms.Name: Search
Terms.Description: Conduct a search for contraband, individuals, or information

Terms.Name: Serve
Terms.Description: Deliver a warning, command, or notice, often as part of enforcing civil code

Terms.Name: Sterilize
Terms.Description: Cleanse an area or remove unwanted elements, often through lethal means

Terms.Name: Suspend
Terms.Description: Pause or halt a particular operation or activity
